global_caption: The video contains 14 shots and is a 15-second news-broadcast-style promotional short that fully transforms a medieval magic castle into a cyberpunk setting. Dominated by cool blue tones with silver-white backlight outlining silhouettes, the camera movement is fast, sharp, and continuous, with occasional stable push-ins to emphasize product information.
shot1: Shot 1 begins with a glitch flash cut, wide overhead view of the entire castle facade. Spire and battlements form strong leading lines converging toward the central tower. Foreground features flag with electric arc texture and stone eaves. Focus locked on the center of the exterior wall, where cool blue neon spreads along brick seams. A large headline "王城快报" floats in the upper half of the frame, centered on the gate, rendered in metallic outline with scanning light material. Dense Chinese scrolling ticker runs rapidly along the bottom edge. As a heavy bell toll and distant crowd commotion simultaneously begin, the headline suddenly illuminates. Camera slightly lowers and pushes in from above.
shot2: Shot 2 continues from previous shot with a hard cut, full shot eye-level view of the drawbridge entrance. Blue-white backlight spills from the castle gate crack. Cold-glow runes hang on both sides of the bridge. The young female anchor stands slightly left of center, with pulsing gate warning runes in the background. Focus follows her as she strides across the bridge, her cloak flaring in the wind. Camera laterally tracks alongside, creating a sense of urgency typical of live news reporting.
shot3: Shot 3 enters via a glitch hard cut, medium-to-close eye-level tracking shot down a long corridor. Arched ceiling recedes into depth, forming a vanishing point. Occasional stone pillars and floating crystals pass in foreground. Shallow depth of field keeps focus on her running profile and passing floating news alerts. Cool blue key light combined with moving top scan lights reflects off armor and walls. Several Chinese news alerts sweep from right to left like a flowing curtain. She quickens pace while glancing upward to confirm info. Camera moves forward quickly with slight pan across the alert layer.
shot4: Shot 4 enters via action-matched hard cut from previous shot, full shot low-angle view of the broadcast hall entrance. Heavy door panels frame the foreground, creating a framing effect. Focus centers on her hand pushing the door. Silver-white backlight bursts from the gap, illuminating blue dust particles. Inside, floating layers and news desk outlines are faintly visible. She steps powerfully through the doorway. Door Camera tilts up slightly from low angle and slides inward following the door’s opening.
shot5: Shot 5 transitions via brief hard cut from interior space to close-up eye-level shot. Composition uses rule of thirds, placing her face and shoulder on the left, with blurred broadcast interface and scrolling text on the right. Focus sharply on the glowing earpiece beside her ear. Soft cool blue light defines facial contours, with silver-white highlights on the earpiece edge. Camera slowly pushes in.
shot6: Shot 6 enters via a glitch frame skip into extreme close-up high-angle shot of the pupil. The frame is nearly filled by one eye. Foreground shows slightly defocused eyelashes. Focus precisely locks on the center of the pupil, which reflects blue data streams, map markers, and scrolling news bars. Cool blue reflection gives the eye edges a glass-like quality. Her gaze shifts from stillness to rapid focus, symbolizing information calibration. Camera gently pushes in to create a sense of pressure.
shot7: Console centered in frame. Semi-transparent floating rune cards pass in foreground. Background features curved broadcast hall wall and dim screens. Focus shifts from her side profile to the illuminated "魔导讯晶终端" logo and map projection at the center of the console. Cool blue key light highlights crystal edges, silver-white rim light traces hand movements. She walks to the console and raises her hand to unfold a virtual map. Paths and city hotspots expand layer by layer with her gestures. Chinese voiceover begins formal delivery “王城关键讯息，即刻汇聚”. Camera performs semi-circular pan to enhance spatial expansion.
shot8: Shot 8 continues from previous shot’s action continuity, direct overhead close-up cut to crystal screen interface. Upper frame shows her hands, lower frame shows crystal screen and pulsing symbols. Clean composition. Focus tightly on fingertips touching the screen. Cool blue light rises from within the screen, illuminating finger joints. Crystal surface ripples with bright concentric waves upon tap. She rapidly taps and swipes, folding, unfolding, and reorganizing multiple sections. Bottom Chinese ticker speed increases noticeably. Camera maintains overhead view with minimal follow motion to keep fingertips centered.
shot9: Shot 9 after final tap triggers glitch flash, cuts to wide overhead view of the main hall. The entire broadcast hall is instantly lit by blue-white beams. Foreground features cluster of floating screens. Background shows towering dome and crowd silhouettes. Focus lands on the sudden explosion of massive text "限时发布" at the center of the hall, slightly above center. She stands beneath it, serving as visual anchor. All screens in the hall flip pages simultaneously. Crowd commotion rises in volume. Anchor’s Camera rapidly drops from high position, creating a burst of information.
shot10: Shot 10 cuts hard from the previous shot to a medium-long eye-level view of the tower window, where the window frame acts as a natural framing device. Outside, the cityscape and floating beacons in the night form the background, while in the foreground she stands sideways by the window broadcasting, her hair gently moved by the night breeze. Cold blue moonlight blends with silver backlighting inside, creating a crisp silhouette. She raises her hand to send a signal into the city; Chinese subtitles appear clearly: “王城讯号已接通”. Distant light points along city pathways rapidly illuminate in response. The camera first pushes slightly, then pulls back subtly, allowing the city's reaction to enter the frame.
shot11: Shot 11 cuts hard via light match from the glowing points outside the window to a close-up eye-level view of the archive room. Long bookshelves extend backward, creating compressed perspective. Slightly blurred document edges appear in the foreground. Focus locks onto the colorful page she opens and the product illustrations emerging on the page. Under cold blue ambient lighting, sharp highlights are cast along the paper edges by silver top light. She quickly flips through illustrated archives; text, images, and symbols animate into floating mini-windows on the page. The camera slides horizontally along the desk, emphasizing efficient sequential retrieval of data.
shot12: Shot 12 cuts hard via action match from the previous shot’s page-turning motion to a wide-angle low-angle view of the stairwell. Focus is on her running upward and the pulsating blue light at the top of the stairs—the signal core. The scene naturally transitions from archival research to signal connection. Cold blue key light flows along the railing, while localized backlight creates sharp highlights along the edge of each step. She ascends rapidly holding a terminal, her cloak and hem flaring with speed. Electronic The camera follows from below, tilting upward with slight rotation, enhancing the sense of sprinting momentum.
shot13: Shot 13 cuts abruptly to a medium close-up, eye-level shot facing the main hall, with symmetrical composition. The product and the person are both centered: in the foreground, her hands cradle the cool blue-glowing "魔导讯晶终端", while the background features a fully activated news matrix wall. Focus initially lands on the texture of the terminal's crystal surface and the flowing light within, then extends to her resolute expression as she looks directly into the camera. Silver-white backlight creates a premium silhouette along the device's edges. In the lower-right corner, the slogan "一触即达" appears in bright metallic text with a brief trailing motion effect. The camera performs a steady push-in, centering the key selling point within the frame.
shot14: Shot 14 concludes with a brief fade-in/fade-out from the previous shot, transitioning to a fixed shot in front of the throne. Wide-angle slightly high-angle view. The throne is centered in the background. In the foreground, the terminal product floats mid-air alongside the broadcaster standing calmly. Focus centers on the product and static text. The entire space is dominated by cold blue key lighting, with only silver backlight outlining the throne edges and stone steps, creating a solemn yet futuristic finale. A dense Chinese scrolling ticker runs continuously along the bottom edge of the screen. A small glitch-style tag "王城快报" remains in the upper-left corner. Near the center-bottom, the product name "魔导讯晶终端" appears in crystalline-metal hybrid typography with subtle glitch tremor. The camera slowly pulls back and freezes to end the sequence.
